```{r}
# 1. Euler plot (similar to Venn diagram)
library(eulerr)
# 6h - 12h post-mating
## all
fit1 <- euler(c(
  "MDsperm" = 215,
  "MDsfp"   = 18,
  "FRG"     = 2055,
  "MDsperm&MDsfp" = 36,
  "MDsperm&FRG"   = 31,
  "MDsfp&FRG"     = 0,
  "MDsperm&MDsfp&FRG" = 5
))

fit2 <- euler(c(
  "MDsperm" = 214,
  "MDsfp"   = 19,
  "FRG"     = 1840,
  "MDsperm&MDsfp" = 34,
  "MDsperm&FRG"   = 34,
  "MDsfp&FRG"     = 1,
  "MDsperm&MDsfp&FRG" = 6
))

p1 <- plot(
  fit1,
  fills = list(
    fill = c(
      adjustcolor("#C98A7B", alpha.f = 0.5),
      adjustcolor("#6D8595", alpha.f = 0.5),
      adjustcolor("#E9D898", alpha.f = 0.5)
    ),
    col = NA
  ),
  edges = list(col = "black"),
  quantities = list(
    cex = 1.2,
    font = 1
  ),
  labels = list(
    cex = 1.3,
    font = 1
  )
)

p2 <- plot(
  fit2,
  fills = list(
    fill = c(
      adjustcolor("#C98A7B", alpha.f = 0.5),
      adjustcolor("#6D8595", alpha.f = 0.5),
      adjustcolor("#E9D898", alpha.f = 0.5)

  quantities = list(
    cex = 1.2,
    font = 1
  ),

    cex = 1.3,
    font = 1
  )
)
```

```{r}
# 2. Stacked bar chart
library(tidyverse)

#####################################################################################
## Changes of all gene/protein categories between 6h and 12h
df <- tribble(
  ~Condition,                 ~Group,            ~Count,
  
  # 6h - FRT + spermatheca
  "6h_all",      "Other MD sperm",   215,
  "6h_all",      "Other MD SFPs",      18,
  "6h_all",      "Uniquely female-derived",       2055,
  "6h_all",      "Sperm-associated SFPs",       41,
  "6h_all",      "Female-associated sperms",       31,
  
  # 6h - FRT
  "6h_FRT",      "Other MD sperm",   231,
  "6h_FRT",      "Other MD SFPs",      18,
  "6h_FRT",      "Uniquely female-derived",       393,
  "6h_FRT",      "Sperm-associated SFPs",       40,
  "6h_FRT",      "Female-associated sperms",       13,
  
  # 6h - Spermatheca
  "6h_spermatheca",      "Other MD sperm",   178,
  "6h_spermatheca",      "Other MD SFPs",      13,
  "6h_spermatheca",      "Uniquely female-derived",       1826,
  "6h_spermatheca",      "Sperm-associated SFPs",       37,
  "6h_spermatheca",      "Female-associated sperms",       18,
  
  # 12h - FRT + spermatheca
  "12h_all",      "Other MD sperm",   214,
  "12h_all",      "Other MD SFPs",      19,
  "12h_all",      "Uniquely female-derived",       1840,
  "12h_all",      "Sperm-associated SFPs",       40,
  "12h_all",      "Female-associated sperms",       34,
  
  # 12h - FRT
  "12h_FRT",      "Other MD sperm",   235,
  "12h_FRT",      "Other MD SFPs",      19,
  "12h_FRT",      "Uniquely female-derived",       440,
  "12h_FRT",      "Sperm-associated SFPs",       40,
  "12h_FRT",      "Female-associated sperms",       10,
  
  # 12h - Spermatheca
  "12h_spermatheca",      "Other MD sperm",   212,
  "12h_spermatheca",      "Other MD SFPs",      11,
  "12h_spermatheca",      "Uniquely female-derived",       1515,
  "12h_spermatheca",      "Sperm-associated SFPs",       36,
  "12h_spermatheca",      "Female-associated sperms",       26,
)

df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    Condition = factor(Condition,
                       levels = c(
                         "6h_all", "12h_all",
                         "6h_FRT", "12h_FRT",
                         "6h_spermatheca", "12h_spermatheca"
                       ))
  )


mycols <- c(
  "Other MD sperm" = "#D5AAA0",
  "Other MD SFPs"   = "#93ADB7",
  "Uniquely female-derived"      = "#F5E4AA",
  "Sperm-associated SFPs"   = "#7E8287",
  "Female-associated sperms"   = "#E0B97A"
)


df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    Condition = factor(Condition,
                       levels = c(
                         "6h_all", "12h_all",
                         "6h_FRT", "12h_FRT",
                         "6h_spermatheca", "12h_spermatheca"
                       ))
  )



plot_pair <- function(data_pair, title_text) {
  ggplot(data_pair, aes(x = Condition, y = Count, fill = Group)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "fill") +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format()) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = mycols) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      panel.grid.major.x = element_blank()
    ) +
    labs(
      title = title_text,
      x = "",
      y = "Percentage",
      fill = "Category"
    )
}


# ===== plot 1: all =====
df_all <- df %>% filter(Condition %in% c("6h_all", "12h_all"))
p_all <- plot_pair(df_all, "FRT + Spermatheca (all)")

# ===== plot 2: FRT =====
df_FRT <- df %>% filter(Condition %in% c("6h_FRT", "12h_FRT"))
p_FRT <- plot_pair(df_FRT, "FRT only")

# ===== plot 3: Spermatheca =====
df_sp <- df %>% filter(Condition %in% c("6h_spermatheca", "12h_spermatheca"))
p_sp <- plot_pair(df_sp, "Spermatheca only")

p_all
p_FRT
p_sp
```
